name: tesserui-bridge
description: Finds TesserAPI nodes on the network (mDNS) and serial ports, and serves them to TesserUI's launcher from localhost
author: Leo Baque

scripts.prepack: mkdir -p ui/ui && cp ../web/dist/index.html ../web/dist/ui.js ../web/dist/launcher.js ui/ && cp ../web/dist/ui/*.js ui/ui/ && cp -R ../web/dist/flash ui/
